# proxmox_acl (Data Source)

Lists the effective ACL entries from `/access/acl`, sorted by path, type and identifier. Filter by `path` and/or `type`; both are prefix/exact matches on single fields, not a path prefix match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_acl" "vm100" {
  path = "/vms/100"
  type = "user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `path` (String) Restrict the result to one ACL path such as `/vms/100`.
- `type` (String) Restrict the result to `user` or `group` entries.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Matching ACL entries, sorted by path, type and identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String)
- `propagate` (Boolean)
- `role_id` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `ugid` (String)
